主要内容: BLONDER TONGUE LABORATORIES INC entered into an Agreement of Sale with Jake Brown Rd LLC, providing for the sale of its Old Bridge, New Jersey facility, which houses the Company’s principal manufacturing, engineering, sales and administrative functions. One of the conditions to the completion of the transactions is Buyer’s completion of certain due diligence matters. Buyer has requested, and the Company has agreed, to extend the due diligence period under the Sale Agreement until the close of business on October 4, 2018.
